title: Blame bitcoin's tumble on rising inflation, not Strategy, 10xResearch argues
summary: The main driver behind bitcoin's weakness was ETF selling after red-hot April U.S. inflation data, 10x's Markus Thielen argued. The bounce may hinge on Wednesday's CPI data, he said.

title: Forehead tattoos and alcohol dares: Inside the dark underbelly of crypto's memecoin craze
